messages.author: 8bdfb890a66f4d45
messages.subject: WLS estimators and conditional.x=FALSE
parts:
Hi,

I am conducting a mediation analysis using lavaan. In my model, X and M are continuous while Y is binary (thus using WLSMV estimator). I am hoping to use bootstrap estimation for testing the significance of the indirect effect. In doing so, I am running into the following error:

> boot <- bootstrapLavaan(fit_mediate, R = 5000, FUN = function(x) { standardizedSolution(x)$est }, verbose = T)

Error in bootstrapLavaan(fit_mediate, R = 5000, FUN = function(x) { : 
  lavaan ERROR: this function is not (yet) available if conditional.x = TRUE


Curiously, when I go back and try to fit my model with conditional.x = FALSE and estimator = 'WLSMV', Lavaan throws the following error:

> fit_mediate <- sem(model = model_mediate, data = Data, estimator = 'WLSMV', conditional.x=F)

Error in computeTH.LISREL(MLIST = GLIST[mm.in.group], th.idx = th.idx[[g]]) : 
  dims [product 2] do not match the length of object [3]
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In muthen1984(Data = X[[g]], ov.names = ov.names[[g]], ov.types = ov.types,  :
  lavaan WARNING: trouble constructing W matrix; used generalized inverse for A11 submatrix
2: In th - (K_nu %*% pi0) :
  longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length

Can anyone point out why this might be happening? Any help would be appreciated.

Cheers,
Vaib

messages.author: 8bdfb890a66f4d45
messages.subject: Re: WLS estimators and conditional.x=FALSE
parts:
Anyone wondering about this error, this has been fixed in the test version 0.6.

- Vaib
